entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fritz Darges was a German SS-Obersturmbannführer in the Waffen-SS during World War II where he was awarded the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross. He served as an adjutant to Martin Bormann and later was a personal adjutant to Adolf Hitler.
